description: Matched 1H execution across 1H,4H,6H,8H DeltaRSI closed-bar signals. No overlapping-position constraints; independent signal excursions, not prop PnL. MFE/MAE use 1H extremes, no fees. Identical 21SMA/12RSI/EMA4 and absolute delta threshold, 210 bar warmup; bar-based indicator lookback represents different wall-clock time. Fixed horizons 24/48/72/120h.
